name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAbove_isPrefix
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAbove_isPrefix (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ) :
    (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).IsPrefix w

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAbove_length_le
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAbove_length_le (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ) :
    (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).length ≤ w.length

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAbove_positive
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAbove_positive (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hpositive : w.Positive) : (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).Positive

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAtLeast_append_drop
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAtLeast_append_drop (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ) :
    w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound ++
        w.drop (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).length = w

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAtLeast_isGreedyBlock
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAtLeast_isGreedyBlock (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hbound : 0 < bound) (hcross : bound ≤ w.span) :
    IsGreedyBlock bound (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound)

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAtLeast_isPrefix
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAtLeast_isPrefix (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ) :
    (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).IsPrefix w

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAtLeast_ne_nil
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAtLeast_ne_nil (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hbound : 0 < bound) (hcross : bound ≤ w.span) :
    w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound ≠ []

name: Erdos260.GapWord.firstPrefixAtLeast_positive
statement:
theorem firstPrefixAtLeast_positive (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hpositive : w.Positive) : (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).Positive

name: Erdos260.GapWord.greedyDecomposeAux_valid
statement:
theorem greedyDecomposeAux_valid (fuel : ℕ) (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hfuel : w.length ≤ fuel) (hbound : 0 < bound) :
    (greedyDecomposeAux fuel w bound).Valid w bound

name: Erdos260.GapWord.greedyDecompose_valid
statement:
theorem greedyDecompose_valid (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hbound : 0 < bound) :
    (greedyDecompose w bound).Valid w bound

name: Erdos260.GapWord.lt_span_firstPrefixAbove_of_lt_span
statement:
theorem lt_span_firstPrefixAbove_of_lt_span (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hcross : bound < w.span) : bound < (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).span

name: Erdos260.GapWord.prefixSpan_firstPrefixAtLeast_lt
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_firstPrefixAtLeast_lt (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hbound : 0 < bound) :
    ∀ r < (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).length,
      (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).prefixSpan r < bound

name: Erdos260.GapWord.span_firstPrefixAbove_le_add
statement:
theorem span_firstPrefixAbove_le_add (w : GapWord) (bound cap : ℕ)
    (hcap : ∀ g ∈ w, g ≤ cap) :
    (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).span ≤ bound + cap

name: Erdos260.GapWord.span_firstPrefixAbove_le_span
statement:
theorem span_firstPrefixAbove_le_span (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ) :
    (w.firstPrefixAbove bound).span ≤ w.span

name: Erdos260.GapWord.span_firstPrefixAtLeast_ge
statement:
theorem span_firstPrefixAtLeast_ge (w : GapWord) (bound : ℕ)
    (hcross : bound ≤ w.span) :
    bound ≤ (w.firstPrefixAtLeast bound).span

name: Erdos260.positiveSupport_infinite
statement:
theorem positiveSupport_infinite {S : Set ℕ} (hS : S.Infinite) :
    (positiveSupport S).Infinite

name: Erdos260.weightedSupportTerm_positiveSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedSupportTerm_positiveSupport (S : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    weightedSupportTerm (positiveSupport S) n = weightedSupportTerm S n

name: Erdos260.eventually_dyadicBlockCount_lt_of_growth
statement:
theorem eventually_dyadicBlockCount_lt_of_growth (a : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n => (a n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) atTop atTop)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℕ in atTop,
      (dyadicBlockCount (Set.range a) (dyadicScale L) : ℝ) <
        c * dyadicScale L

name: Erdos260.hasSum_range_weightedSupport
statement:
theorem hasSum_range_weightedSupport (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) :
    HasSum (weightedSupportTerm (Set.range a))
      (∑' n : ℕ, natSequenceTerm a n)

name: Erdos260.natSequenceTerm_eq_weightedSupport_comp
statement:
theorem natSequenceTerm_eq_weightedSupport_comp (a : ℕ → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) :
    natSequenceTerm a n = weightedSupportTerm (Set.range a) (a n)

name: Erdos260.range_infinite_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem range_infinite_of_strictMono (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) :
    (Set.range a).Infinite

name: Erdos260.summable_nat_weight
statement:
theorem summable_nat_weight :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)

name: Erdos260.summable_weightedSupportTerm
statement:
theorem summable_weightedSupportTerm (S : Set ℕ) :
    Summable (weightedSupportTerm S)
